bounds.domain: Two providers sharing one account id, two one-shot refresh callers, two initial records and one explicit save (at most three fresh replacement generations). Credential values 1..4, identity tokens absent or 1..4, labels 1..2. Label is the mutable metadata projection; other owner metadata is held constant. Identity tokens are absent or nonempty.
bounds.assumptions: Every storage call is atomic under the existing process/file lock. UUID generation is collision-free. The host root is valid and private. Cryptography, path admission, filesystem failure, reset/delete transactions, legacy upgrade and cross-process lock recovery require separate models.
bounds.progress: Weak fairness of each pending refresh completion implies it settles. Provider/network completion is an explicit environment assumption. Each refresh caller starts once and can complete once; one explicit save bounds replacement generations without disabling pending completions.

assumptions: Checked formula in AccountCredentialGeneration: RefreshCallsSettle = FairRefreshCompletion.implies( readers.forall(reader => always((s.readers.get(reader).stage == "waiting").implies( eventually(s.readers.get(reader).stage != "waiting")))))
Model fairness predicate FairRefreshCompletion = readers.forall(reader => refresh(reader, false).weakFair(s) and refresh(reader, true).weakFair(s))
The property is conditional on its written model fairness and environmental premises. Real scheduler fairness, provider completion and implementation refinement are not proved.
